AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food food frying food? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food food frying food.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food food frying food.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food food frying food.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food food frying food.

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Ice melting to water

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds? (1 mark)

   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Fruits? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Fruits.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Fruits.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Fruits.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Fruits.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of Domestic Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of Domestic Animals.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of Domestic Animals.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of Domestic Animals.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of Domestic Animals.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Balanced Meal? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Balanced Meal.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Balanced Meal.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Balanced Meal.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Balanced Meal.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fuel Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fuel Conservation.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fuel Conservation.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fuel Conservation.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fuel Conservation.

9. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. watt (W)
   C. newton (N)
   D. pascal (Pa)

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Wild Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Wild Animals.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Wild Animals.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Wild Animals.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Wild Animals.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Domestic Hygiene? (1 mark)

   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Domestic Hygiene.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Domestic Hygiene.

12. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Producers

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Balanced Meal and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Cooking Food food frying food and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Personal Hygiene and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Domestic Hygiene and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
